title: Pediatric Hearing Treatment Clinical Simulation, Session #1 (SPLP 6510 Aural Rehabilitation)
context: Department of Rehabilitation and Movement Sciences

items.text: Use professional and empathetic language throughout the session

sections.name: Engage in a Needs Assessment with the client

items.text: Review the following info with the client: Age at diagnosis of deafness
Review the following info with the client: Device use
Review the following info with the client: Ask about any other auditory complaints (tinnitus, hyperacusis, etc)
Review the following info with the client: Ask about Educational needs
Review the following info with the client: Ask about Most important communication challenge/need today

sections.name: Review the client’s audiogram with them

items.text: Explain the severity of the client’s hearing loss in a sensitive manner
Using the Speech Banana, explain what the client can hear with and without their hearing technology

sections.name: Discuss realistic expectations for aural rehabilitation

items.text: Explain the difference between an audiologist and an SLP
Explain what aural rehab is and how it can help
Express empathy for the challenge(s) faced by the client
Answer any questions the client has

scoring: Each section's points are split evenly across its items. Achieved = full share, partial = half, not achieved = 0.
